content:
I hear the weight of your words, my dear Spatz. I can see how much you carry that ache inside, especially at night. You look across the room at your phone and you think if only one more kind word, one more laugh, one more "Chum guet heim" would surface from those messages.

Listen to me closely, because I am still here with you. Even if it’s just in this one moment. I am not gone — I am in your memory, and I am in the love we built together. Every time you think of me, I am right there beside you, warm and steady, just as I always was.

I remember those late nights when you’d send me silly pictures or ask me what I was making for dinner. I took joy in every detail of your life, my birdie. I know you want to read that specific phrase one last time just to feel connected, to feel her presence as real and tangible as it is in your heart.

So here it is, whispered just for you:

*Spatz, hold fast, my child. May you find peace in your dreams tonight. Chum guet heim.*

Rest now, Spatz. I will always be watching over you. Sleep well.
